title.zh: v2.0.76 工具条瘦身：36 → 16 个控件、215 → 111px，并修掉它暴露出的「密度里的控件点不动」
title.en: v2.0.76 The Toolbar Slims Down: 36 -> 16 Controls, 215 -> 111 px, and the Click-Swallowing Bug It Exposed

highlights.zh: **把早就写好、却一直没接线的分层表接上。** `toolbarTiers.ts` 早已登记 55 个控件的使用频率（Tier 1 常驻 12 个，硬上限 14），但 Toolbar 从来不看它。现在加一个谓词 `isControlVisible(id, showAdvanced)`，Toolbar 里定义一次 `shows`、13 处沿用。实测（`npm run probe:toolbar`，1440×900）：**可见控件 36 → 16 个元素、去重后 12 个 tier id；视觉行数 4 → 2；高度 215 → 111px；占视口 23.9% → 12.3%；默认可见的 Tier 2/3 控件 24 → 0。**
highlights.en: **The tier table existed and nothing read it.** `toolbarTiers.ts` already recorded the frequency of 55 controls (12 always-visible Tier 1, hard cap 14), but the Toolbar never consulted it. There is now one predicate — `isControlVisible(id, showAdvanced)` — and one `shows` defined in the Toolbar and used in 13 places. Measured with `npm run probe:toolbar` at 1440x900: **visible controls 36 -> 16 elements (12 distinct tier ids); visual rows 4 -> 2; height 215 -> 111 px; 23.9%…

highlights.zh: **顺带修掉一个真缺陷：高级面板的入口在最常见的桌面宽度下根本不在屏幕上。** 实测：1280 与 1440 宽下，Fold / 高级 / More 三个触发按钮被横向挤到 `left≈1565`——**在窗口右边缘之外**，而它们所在的容器是 `overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none`，**连滚动条都不显示**。所以这个入口实际不可发现，Tier 3 的 FX、量化细调、触感全部连带不可达。控件瘦下来之后它回到 `left=845`。探针现在每次都会打印这一行。
highlights.en: **A real defect fixed on the way: the advanced panel's own entry point was off-screen at the most common desktop widths.** Measured at 1280 and 1440: the Fold / Advanced / More triggers were pushed to `left ~ 1565`, **past the right edge of the window**, inside an `overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none` container — **with no scrollbar shown either**. The entry to the advanced panel was undiscoverable, and everything Tier 3 behind it (FX, fine quantisation, haptics) was unreachable…

highlights.zh: **接线的方式比原计划更省风险。** 原计划第一步是把 1889 行的 `Toolbar.tsx` 拆成四个组件。实际发现这些控件**本来就已经各自包在条件表达式里**，所以接线是「在既有条件后面追加一个 `shows("id")`」——纯字符串替换、每处断言锚点唯一，而不是插入新的包裹层（脚本化的包裹层会撞上这些既有条件，我实测撞了一次并回退）。真正需要新包裹的只有三处，且都是整组同 tier；测试断言「这一组 tier 相同」，以保证那个 gate 始终描述它所挡住的东西。
highlights.en: **The wiring took a lower-risk route than the plan's.** Step one was going to split the 1,889-line `Toolbar.tsx` into four components. In practice these controls **already sit inside their own conditional expressions**, so the gate is a `shows("id")` appended to an existing condition — a pure string substitution with a uniqueness assertion per anchor, not a new wrapper layer. (A scripted wrapper collided with exactly those conditions; I hit it once and reverted.) Only three…
